From a6b227d70d2ad9eb08adc3fe532ebb7ec88ac897 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Yazen Ghannam <yazen.ghannam@amd.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Mar 2024 20:32:52 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] RAS: Avoid build errors when CONFIG_DEBUG_FS=n

A new helper was introduced for RAS modules to be able to get the RAS
subsystem debugfs root directory. The helper is defined in debugfs.c
which is only built when CONFIG_DEBUG_FS=y.

However, it's possible that the modules would include debugfs support
for optional functionality. One current example is the fmpm module. In
this case, a build error will occur when CONFIG_RAS_FMPM is selected and
CONFIG_DEBUG_FS=n.

Add an inline helper function stub for the CONFIG_DEBUG_FS=n case as the
fmpm module can function without the debugfs functionality too.

Fixes: 9d2b6fa09d15 ("RAS: Export helper to get ras_debugfs_dir")
Closes: https://bugzilla.kernel.org/show_bug.cgi?id=218640
Reported-by: anthony s. knowles <akira.2020@protonmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Yazen Ghannam <yazen.ghannam@amd.com>
Signed-off-by: Borislav Petkov (AMD) <bp@alien8.de>
Tested-by: anthony s. knowles <akira.2020@protonmail.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20240325183755.776-1-bp@alien8.de

diff --git a/drivers/ras/debugfs.h b/drivers/ras/debugfs.h
index 4749ccdeeba1..5a2f48439258 100644
--- a/drivers/ras/debugfs.h
+++ b/drivers/ras/debugfs.h
@@ -4,6 +4,10 @@
 
 #include <linux/debugfs.h>
 
+#if IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_DEBUG_FS)
 struct dentry *ras_get_debugfs_root(void);
+#else
+static inline struct dentry *ras_get_debugfs_root(void) { return NULL; }
+#endif /* DEBUG_FS */
 
 #endif /* __RAS_DEBUGFS_H__ */
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/ras/debugfs.h`**
   - A conditional compilation block was added to define the function `ras_get_debugfs_root()`.
   - If `CONFIG_DEBUG_FS` is enabled, the function declaration remains as is: `struct dentry *ras_get_debugfs_root(void);`.
   - If `CONFIG_DEBUG_FS` is not enabled, an inline helper function stub is introduced: `static inline struct dentry *ras_get_debugfs_root(void) { return NULL; }`.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in `debugfs.h` addresses a build issue that arises when the `CONFIG_DEBUG_FS` option is disabled while `CONFIG_RAS_FMPM` is enabled. By providing a stub for the `ras_get_debugfs_root()` function when debugfs support is not available, the patch ensures that the fmpm module can still compile and function correctly without the debugfs functionality. This change is a direct response to the reported build error and is intended to maintain compatibility and prevent errors in the build process.

RAS: Avoid build errors when CONFIG_DEBUG_FS=n

A new helper was introduced for RAS modules to be able to get the RAS
subsystem debugfs root directory. The helper is defined in debugfs.c
which is only built when CONFIG_DEBUG_FS=y.

However, it's possible that the modules would include debugfs support
for optional functionality. One current example is the fmpm module. In
this case, a build error will occur when CONFIG_RAS_FMPM is selected and
CONFIG_DEBUG_FS=n.

Add an inline helper function stub for the CONFIG_DEBUG_FS=n case as the
fmpm module can function without the debugfs functionality too.

Fixes: 9d2b6fa09d15 ("RAS: Export helper to get ras_debugfs_dir")
Closes: https://bugzilla.kernel.org/show_bug.cgi?id=218640

Here is the root cause:
The bug occurs because the `ras_get_debugfs_root()` function is defined in `debugfs.c`, which is only compiled when `CONFIG_DEBUG_FS` is enabled. If `CONFIG_DEBUG_FS` is disabled while `CONFIG_RAS_FMPM` is enabled, the fmpm module attempts to call this function, leading to a build error due to its absence. The inline stub added in the patch prevents this error by providing a fallback implementation that returns `NULL` when debugfs is not available.

 struct dentry *ras_get_debugfs_root(void);
+#else
+static inline struct dentry *ras_get_debugfs_root(void) { return NULL; }
+#endif /* DEBUG_FS */
 
 #endif /* __RAS_DEBUGFS_H__ */
